heading: Built on a strong foundation
subtext: Three core principles that guide every component, config, and workflow decision.

items.title: Config-first
items.description: Every page starts as JSON. Content, layout, SEO, and media are all defined in structured data files that agents and humans can edit equally.

items.title: Theme-driven
items.description: A shared token system means every component adapts to light or dark mode, brand colors, and typography without manual overrides.

items.title: Zero-JS by default
items.description: Components ship zero client JavaScript. Static HTML rendered at build time means fast loads, no layout shift, and perfect Lighthouse scores.
